prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 14 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1445; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- The patient was treated for the same body area within the last two years, and that condition adds to the current complaints.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Patient presented following a sideswipe collision during a lane change, reporting neck pain, stiffness, and headache consistent with cervical whiplash. The mechanism and force of impact are considered well matched to the reported injury. Over the course of 14 visits, care included manual therapy, targeted exercise, and home stretching, following a typical recovery pattern with visit frequency tapering as symptoms improved. Examination revealed reduced cervical range of motion and paraspinal muscle tenderness that support the clinical picture, while several neurological and orthopedic screening tests returned normal results. Review of the record also shows prior treatment for the same cervical region within the past two years, and that earlier condition is judged to contribute to some of the current complaints and should be considered when assessing residual symptoms. Two billing entries for the same date of service are currently under review for accuracy. Prognosis is good with continued home exercise, and the patient is expected to reach maximum improvement with routine follow-up as needed.
